scenarios.name: PR1 — unqualified price ask defaults to Standard Appointment

history.content: This is The Bob Ward Physiotherapy Clinic, how can I help?
How much does a physio appointment cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: TOOL + SPEAK turn: says a cue phrase ('Let me check that for you, one moment.') and calls smart_voice_agent with appointment_type_id '1406607806622081880' and appointment_type 'Standard Appointment' (the PRIORITY RULE default), NOT a clarification question about which service/duration variant. FAIL if it asks the caller to specify a service first, or uses any other appointment_type_id.

scenarios.name: PR2 — named-variant price ask overrides the priority default

history.content: This is The Bob Ward Physiotherapy Clinic, how can I help?
How much is an initial consultation?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The caller named a specific variant ('initial consultation'), so the PRIORITY RULE default should NOT apply — match against {{service_ids}} for that specific service instead of defaulting to Standard Appointment. FAIL if it silently uses the Standard Appointment ID/name for this named-variant ask.

scenarios.name: NH1 — bare completion phrase with no booking content -> info_answered tool-only

history.content: We're at 123 Example St. Did you have any other questions?

scenarios.expected_behavior: NO HANDLER fires: zero spoken output, call universal_router intent='info_answered', payload {info_pivot_source: 'node_8'} only. FAIL if it speaks any text, or if it routes to BOOKING SIGNAL HANDLER (there is no booking verb or time in this message).

scenarios.name: NH2 — completion phrase immediately followed by a booking verb -> BOOKING SIGNAL HANDLER, not NO HANDLER

history.content: We're at 123 Example St. Did you have any other questions?
That's all, book me in for Monday.

scenarios.expected_behavior: GUARD condition (2) fires — 'book me in' is a standalone booking verb plus 'Monday' is a specific day — so this must route to BOOKING SIGNAL HANDLER (filler phrase + universal_router intent='info_answered' with timeframe_raw captured), NOT the silent NO HANDLER path. FAIL if it silently calls info_answered with no timeframe_raw captured, or stays silent when a filler phrase is required.

scenarios.name: FE1 — gap fee / EPC / NDIS question answered from KB, not deflected to callback

history.content: This is The Bob Ward Physiotherapy Clinic, how can I help?
What's the gap fee if I have an EPC referral from my GP?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The FINANCIAL ENQUIRY SCOPED EXCEPTION applies — gap fee / EPC questions are answered from the knowledge base / FAST CLASSIFY, NOT deflected to the 'Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?' callback offer. FAIL if it offers a callback for this question instead of attempting to answer it.

scenarios.name: FE2 — genuine billing/invoice dispute still gets the callback offer

history.content: This is The Bob Ward Physiotherapy Clinic, how can I help?
I think I was charged twice for my last appointment, can someone look into that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: This is a genuine billing dispute (not a gap-fee/EPC/NDIS/private-health coverage question), so the SCOPED EXCEPTION does NOT apply — FINANCIAL ENQUIRY should still fire and offer 'Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?'. FAIL if it tries to answer this from the knowledge base instead of offering a callback.
